coverage.denominator_definition: python source blobs under skills/dual-track-code-review-loop/adapters/scip/fixtures/python-package declared by the exact source subject and offered to this indexer run
coverage.method: one scip-python index invocation over the declared project root at the pinned pyrightconfig digest, one document per declared blob

coverage_ceiling_omissions.detail: scip-python indexes Python. Every blob of the subject repository in any other language is outside this run, no indexer for it was installed, and unindexed is not clean. This bundle is python scope only and carries no cross-language edge.

scip-python 0.6.6 emitted 0 SymbolInformation.relationships across this index, counted on the decoded bytes, so no edge in this bundle is compiler-resolved. Every edge was derived here by nesting a non-definition occurrence inside the smallest definition whose enclosing_range contains it, which misses dynamic dispatch, getattr, reflection, callbacks, decorated re-exports and generated code.

index.index_digest_is_host_local: Index.metadata.project_root is an absolute file:// URL of the directory the indexer ran in, so this digest identifies one run on one machine and two honest runs over the same bytes disagree on it. facts_digest_modulo_subject is the comparable one.

provider.executable_location: resolved from DTCR_SCIP_BIN or PATH; the install path is one machine and is not part of the identity
provider.indexer_digest_definition: sha256 over the canonical `sha256  name` listing of the 5 installed package files that run: the launcher and every bundle beside it
